certificates.title: Duba takardar shaida
certificates.text: Saka a nan takardar shaidar da aka ajiye daga Game da wannan amsa, hujjarta, ko duka biyun, tare da kowane fayil da za ta iya ambata. Ko kuma saka hoto ko bidiyo don karanta yadda aka yi shi. Babu abin da ke barin wannan shafi.
certificates.unreadable: Wannan ba takardar shaidar amsa ba ce, ba hujjarta ba ce, kuma ba hoto ko bidiyo ne da ke faɗin yadda aka yi shi ba.
certificates.intact: An rufe ta, kuma ba ta canza ba tun lokacin
certificates.broken: An canza ta, ko ba a rufe ta da maɓallin da ta ambata ba
certificates.where.device: An yi a na’urar da ta rufe ta
certificates.where.outside: An aika waje da na’urar da ta rufe ta
certificates.where.unknown: Ba a tabbatar da inda aka yi ta ba
certificates.unproven: Wannan hujja ba ta wannan takardar shaida ba ce
certificates.notFile: {name} ba fayil ne da ta ambata ba
certificates.badDate: Kwanan watan da bai tsaya ba
certificates.notLogged: Ba ta cikin rajistar jama’ar da ta ambata
certificates.credentials: {name} na ɗauke da bayanin yadda aka yi shi da aka sa wa hannu, ba a canza ba tun lokacin
certificates.credentialsBroken: Bayanin yadda aka yi {name} bai tsaya ba: an canza shi tun lokacin, ko ba a sa masa hannu da maɓallin da ya ambata ba
certificates.ai: Bayanin ya ce ƙirƙirarriyar basira ce ta yi shi
certificates.notAi: Bayanin bai ce ƙirƙirarriyar basira ce ta yi shi ba
certificates.unbound: Ba a duba a nan ko fayil ɗin ya canza tun lokacin ba
certificates.noRecord: {name} ba shi da bayanin yadda aka yi shi
certificates.watermark.match: Alamar ruwansa marar ganuwa ita ce wadda wannan bayani ya ambata
certificates.watermark.other: Alamar ruwansa marar ganuwa ba wadda wannan bayani ya ambata ba ce
certificates.watermark.found: Akwai alamar ruwa marar ganuwa a cikinsa
certificates.watermark.none: Ba a sami alamar ruwa marar ganuwa ba
certificates.watermark.unread: Bayan an nemi alamar ruwa marar ganuwa da {name} a wannan na’ura, wannan shafi ma zai nema
certificates.words: Ko liƙa kalmomi don neman alamar ruwa ta ƙwaƙwalwar da ke kan na’ura a cikinsu
certificates.words.marked: Waɗannan kalmomi suna da alamar ruwa ta ƙwaƙwalwar da ke kan na’ura: ita ta rubuta su, ko wani ya sa su yi kama da haka
certificates.words.none: Babu alamar ruwa ta ƙwaƙwalwar da ke kan na’ura a cikin waɗannan kalmomi: ba ita ta rubuta su ba, ko an sake rubuta su tun daga lokacin
certificates.words.short: Kalmomin sun yi kaɗan don a faɗa: liƙa kusan shafi ɗaya
certificates.words.unread: Bayan an nemi alamar ruwa a cikin kalmomi da {name} a wannan na’ura, wannan shafi ma zai nema
